title: Fastly and Ingram Micro Partner to Accelerate AI-Ready Digital Infrastructure in Singapore
summary: SINGAPORE - September 1, 2026 – Fastly, Inc (NASDAQ: FSLY), a leading edge cloud platform provider, today announced a distribution partnership with Ingram Micro, marking Fastly's first distribution agreement in Singapore and strengthening its commitment to the country's enterprise market.
body_markdown:
**SINGAPORE - September 1, 2026** – Fastly, Inc (NASDAQ: FSLY), a leading edge cloud platform provider, today announced a distribution partnership with Ingram Micro, marking Fastly's first distribution agreement in Singapore and strengthening its commitment to the country's enterprise market. As organisations accelerate the adoption of AI, cloud-native applications and API-driven services, they are increasingly seeking platforms that can deliver performance, security and programmability at scale. Through Ingram Micro's extensive partner ecosystem, Fastly's programmable edge cloud platform will enable organisations to build faster, more secure and more resilient digital experiences.


Fastly's programmable edge cloud platform will help organisations throughout Ingram Micro’s extensive network of resellers and systems integrators modernise the infrastructure that powers their websites, applications and APIs. As enterprises navigate the opportunities and challenges of AI adoption, Fastly helps them deliver high-performance digital experiences, strengthen application security, and simplify operations through a single, programmable platform.


Fastly's customers in Singapore can expect:


-


Improved digital performance to deliver better customer experiences and support business growth.


-


Greater cyber resilience to protect business-critical applications and minimise downtime.


-


The scalability and flexibility needed to support AI, cloud-native applications and modern digital services.


-


Simplified operations through a unified platform for performance, security and compute.


-


Faster access to expertise and local support through Ingram Micro's partner ecosystem.


Ingram Micro’s channel partners will benefit from:


-


Access to Fastly's programmable edge cloud platform, enabling partners to deliver modern application delivery, security and compute solutions to enterprise customers.


-


Training, technical enablement and go-to-market support to help partners expand their cloud and cybersecurity service offerings.


-


New opportunities to help organisations modernise legacy infrastructure and strengthen their cyber resilience in the AI era.


-


The ability to support customers on their AI and cloud transformation journeys through secure, high-performance digital infrastructure.


"Enterprises across Singapore are rethinking the infrastructure that powers their digital experiences as AI, cloud-native applications and APIs become increasingly central to business growth," said Rachel Ler, Area Vice President, Asia at Fastly. "Organisations need platforms that can deliver performance, security and programmability at scale, without adding complexity. Together with Ingram Micro, we’re expanding access to Fastly’s edge cloud platform and equipping partners with the technology, expertise and support they need to help customers build AI-ready digital experiences that are fast, secure and resilient."


“This partnership with Fastly reflects our shared commitment to helping enterprises modernise their digital infrastructure for the AI era,” said Eunice Lau, Executive Managing Director at Ingram Micro. “By combining Fastly's programmable edge cloud platform with Ingram Micro's extensive partner ecosystem, the collaboration will equip organisations with the performance, security and resilience needed to power the next generation of digital experiences.”


**About Fastly**


Fastly’s powerful and programmable edge cloud platform helps the world’s top brands deliver online experiences that are fast, safe, and engaging through edge compute, delivery, security, and observability offerings that improve site performance, enhance security, and empower innovation at a global scale. Compared to other providers, Fastly’s powerful, high-performance, and modern platform architecture empowers developers to deliver secure websites and apps with rapid time-to-market and demonstrated, industry-leading cost savings. Organizations around the world trust Fastly to help them upgrade the internet experience, including Reddit, Universal Music Group, and SeatGeek. Learn more about Fastly at[https://www.fastly.com](https://www.fastly.com/) , and follow us[@fastly](https://www.linkedin.com/company/fastly/) .
